book.name: Roma
book.title: Paulas ke tjietthie Roma ke iesaai log khaatien

content: Pawietr Aatma ke kaam
Aise hai kie dje Kriest Jiesoe me saamiel hai, Parmeswar oke be-kasoerie maaniega.
Pawietr Aatma ke naawa kaanoen hai kie oe toelogke Kriest Jiesoe dwaara naawa djiewan deis hai aur toelogke paap aur maut ke bas me se batjaais hai.

Manai logan pahiela kaanoen par tjale ke dwaara na batj paais. Ohie se Parmeswar aapan Beta ke doenia par pathaais paap hataawe khaatien. Okar man sab doesar iensaan ke man ghat raha, bakie biena paap ke. Tab Parmeswar manai logan ke paap dwaara faisala karies oke kasoerwaar maane ke.
Oe aise karies djeme hamlog okar kaanoen poera karie. Djab hamlog aapan man waala tjhor debe aur Pawietr Aatma ke dwaara tjalab, tab hamlog okar kaanoen par tjal paabe.
Dje aapan man waala kare hai, oe khaalie aapan laalietj poera kare hai. Bakie dje Pawietr Aatma se tjale hai, oe okar man waala kare hai.
Dje aapan man waala kare hai, oe maut ke rasta par tjale hai. Bakie djab Pawietr Aatma hamlogke tjalaawe hai, tab hamlog Parmeswar ke sanghe sjaantie se aapan djiewan bietaabe.
Hamlogke aur Parmeswar ke man waala djaise doesman hai. Hamlog na maangiela okar kaanoen par tjale aur aise na kar sakiela.
Dje aapan man waala kare hai, oe Parmeswar ke na parsand kar paawe hai.

Bakie toelogke haalat ab doesar rakam hai. Djab Parmeswar ke Aatma toelogke diel me rahe hai, tab toelog aapan paapie man dwaara na tjalaawal dja hai bakie okare dwaara. Djekar diel me oe na rahe hai, oe Jiesoe Kriest me saamiel na hai.
Djab Kriest tor diel me rahe hai, tab tjaahe paap dwaara tor dehie maut ke bas me hai, tabbo toe Parmeswar se ek baate aur ohie se tor aatma djieje hai.
Parmeswar Kriest Jiesoe ke djie oethaais hai, aur djab okar Aatma tor diel me rahe hai, tab oe okare dwaara tor mattie ke dehie ke djie oethaaiga.
Bhaai-bahien logan, ohie se hamlogke na tjaahie aapan man waala kare ke.
Djab toe aise kariehe, tab tor aatma Parmeswar se alag karal djaai. Bakie djab toe Pawietr Aatma dwaara tjaliehe aur aapan tjaal-tjalan ke samhariehe, tab tor aatma Parmeswar ke aage djienda rahiega.
Har ek djaun okar Aatma dwaara tjale hai, oe Parmeswar ke beta aur bietia hai.

Djaun Aatma Parmeswar toke deis hai, oe toke aapan goelaam na banaais hai phien se dar ke bas me rahe khaatien. Na, oe toelogke Parmeswar ke betwan aur bietian banaais hai, aur okar dwaara hamlog Parmeswar ke bolaaila: „He Abba, he Baap!”
Parmeswar ke Aatma hamlogke aatma sanghe gawaahie dewe hai kie hamlog Parmeswar ke larkan baatie.

Aur djab hamlog Parmeswar ke larkan hai, tab hamlog bhie hakdaar baatie. Hamlog Kriest ke sanghe hak paabe djab hamlog okar bieswaasie ghat bhie doekh oethaabe. Aur ant me hamlog okar biesaal soekh me bhaag lebe.
Parmeswar ke larkan ke aasa
Ham to thiek se djaaniela kie djetana doekh hamlogke oethaawe ke parie, ie khaalie thora dien khaat rahie aur djab Parmeswar hamlogke aapan biesaal soekh me bhiettar leiga, tab hamlog bhoelaai djaab.
Saara sansaar bahoet agore hai djab talak Parmeswar na dekhaaiga kie okar betwan aur bietian ke hai.
Sab tjiedj aur sab koi to maut ke bas me hai aur patjhare hai. Ie koi na maange hai, bakie paap ke dwaara Parmeswar aise sallaah karies hai.
Tabbo saara sansaar batj djaaiga Parmeswar ke larkan ke sanghe biesaal soekh me bhaag lewe khaatien.
Djab ek aurat ke larka paida howe hai, tab oke kahare ke pare hai. Oisane hamlog djaaniela kie ab talak doenia aur swarag me sab tjiedj kahare hai.
Aur tjaahe hamlog Pawietr Aatma paai tjoekalie hai, tabbo hamahoelog bahoet agoriela djab talak hamlog Parmeswar ke betwan-bietian ghat maut aur piera me se tjhoetkaara na paabe.
Djab hamlog bieswaas karke agoriela, tab hamlog batj djaabe. Ie sab tjiedj abbe na bhail hai. Djab aise bhail rahat, tab hamlog na agortie.
Bakie djab talak na bhail hai, tab talak hamlog hiemmat pakarke agorab.

Hamlog apane se na kar paaila aur na djaaniela kaise praatna kare ke tjaahie. Bakie Pawietr Aatma hamlogke sahaaita kare hai aur hamlog khaatien praatna kare hai aisan baat se djaun hamlog kabhie na bol paitie.
Aur Parmeswar sab iensaan ke diel me khodj kare hai aur oe samdjhe hai Pawietr Aatma bieswaasie log khaatien kaun tjiedj maange hai. Oe to khaalie Parmeswar ke man waala maange hai.
Hamlog djaaniela kie Parmeswar sab tjiedj kaam me laawe hai bhalaai kare khaatien djaun log oke pjaar kare hai aur bolaawal gail hai.
Parmeswar agwe se djaanat raha kie ke rahiega aur sallaah karies kie oesab okar Beta ner hoiga djeme oe dher bhaai-bahien ke sab se barka Waala rahe.
Aur dje ke oe tjoenies raha, oe oesabke bolaais hai. Tab oe oesabke be-kasoerie aur apane se ek banaais hai aur bhie aapan biesaal soekh me bhiettar leiga.
Parmeswar ke pjaar se koetjh na hamlogke alag kar paaiga
Hamlog ie sab tjiedj ke biese me kaun tjiedj bol sakiela? Djab Parmeswar hamlogke sanghe hai, tab ke hamlogke rok sakiega?
Parmeswar aapan Beta ke na batjaais, bakie oke aapan doesman ke haath me saup deis hamlogke paap me se batjaawe khaatien. Tab oe to hamlogke bhalaai karke sab doesar tjiedj bhie deiga.
Parmeswar hamlogke tjoenies hai, tab ke hamlogke kasoer dei sake hai? Djab oe hamlogke kasoer lei leis hai,

tab ke hamlogke kasoer dei sake hai? Kriest Jiesoe mar tjoekal hai, aur sab se biesaal tjiedj hai kie oe djie oethal hai. Aur ab oe Parmeswar ke dahiena bagal baithal hai. Hoewa par oe hamlogke khaatien ose batia hai.

Ke hamlogke Kriest ke pjaar se alag kar paaiga? Tjaahe koi hamlogke doekh me daarie kie sataai, tjaahe hamlogke kamtie khaaik aur kapra mielie, tjaahe koetjh hamlogke derwaai, kie tjaahe koi hamlogke maangie maar dhaare, tabbo koetjh na hamlogke Kriest ke pjaar se alag kar paaiga!
Parmeswar ke poestak me liekhal hai kie:

content.text: „Hamlog tor saathie log baatie, ohie se oesab hamlogke khasie ghat maane hai aur har ek mauka par maange hai maar dhaare.”

content: Bakie ie sab moesiebat me hamlog Jiesoe Kriest ke dwaara hardam djiet djaabe. Oe to hamlogke bahoet pjaar kare hai.

Ham thiek se djaaniela kie koetjh na hamlogke okar pjaar se alag kar paaiga. Maut, djiewan, parie log, raadj tjalaawe waalan, aadj ke aur aane waala tjiedj, aur ekko saktie Parmeswar ke pjaar na rok paaiga.
Oe hamlogke Prabhoe Jiesoe Kriest dwaara tjaahe hai, aur ohie se hamlog tjaahe djetana oeppar kie to gahier me rahabe, tabbo ekko banaawal tjiedj hamlogke okar pjaar se na alag kar paaiga.
